decisions.change: Give print-label and QR-drop-off draft states equal prominence, incorporate runtime discovery, and distinguish observed drafts from verified completion.

Place the conflict near the top with full requested and observed destination labels, current deduction and refund, and Restore my choices. Keep the completed conflict state visibly distinct from a running source check.
Separate requested choices from observed values, preserve original-payment intent, render amounts from runtime data, and expose unknown terms without inventing quotes.

Show Keep jacket without an editable return toggle. Allow only explicit choice and check actions, lock controls while processing or after receipt, and leave starting, exact approval, submission, and confirmation to the host.
Explain that initial read-only exploration blocked draft writes rather than presenting item and reason interactions as fully verified.
Use visible labels, native controls, a live status region, strong forest-on-cream contrast, keyboard focus outlines, and a responsive single-column layout.
